response.overview: Award-winning director Adrian embarks on a path to catch his next story. In a quaint coastal town with a haunting history, the mysterious arrest of a remarkable detective, John Carter, and his associate and best friend, Peter Grey, over the case of Michael Carter's Last Note. In an attempt to cover his story, he quickly becomes ensnared in the web of John's family's past, where music, memory, and loss intertwine.
response.title: The Last Note
